fixes.what: Start the fade earlier: `#000 55%, transparent 100%`, and lengthen .descend::after to 220px so both trunk strips dissolve into the night well before the How-we-work band.
fixes.why: At 1440 (desktop-1) both trunks end on a near-flat horizontal edge ~30px above the band: the tree looks sawn off instead of descending into the ground.

fixes.what: Push it off the frame edge: `left:-70px; top:clamp(16px,3vh,40px)` so a third of the sprig is cropped by the viewport, matching the half-cut trunks.
fixes.why: On desktop-3 the leaf sits fully inside the page corner and reads as a floating clip-art sprig, not part of the tree that frames the edges.

fixes.what: Raise the desktop bar to `rgba(27,34,30,.985)` while keeping the 8px blur.
fixes.why: Desktop-4 shows the form's input boxes and labels ghosting through the bar as faint rectangles; the bar should be a clean night band.

fixes.what: Use `border-radius:2px` to match the 2px-radius panels, inputs, the How-we-work tab and the 2px gold rules.
fixes.why: The pill is the one rounded shape in an otherwise square editorial system; a squared gold button reads premium and consistent, the pill reads startup.

fixes.what: Set `filter:blur(4px) brightness(.7)` and the overlay to `rgba(18,23,20,.9)→rgba(18,23,20,.6)` so every collapsed strip sits in the same tonal range.
fixes.why: Desktop-2 shows one bright smeared strip (the hand photo) next to near-black strips; the five strips should read as one quiet set with the open panel as the single bright moment.

fixes.what: Give the English line the gold colour (var(--gold)) and keep the Persian twin in parchment.
fixes.why: On desktop-0 the tag pair is two parchment strings on painted leaves; a gold English cap line ties the first screen's brand line to the logo and the gold system above it.
